versions.changelog:
Initial release — guided workflow for structured Game Design Document (GDD) writing.

- Interactive, section-by-section GDD builder with templates for overview, mechanics, systems, levels, narrative, and more.
- Multi-platform usage notes for OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and chat-based LLMs.
- Produces organized output: separated markdown files or master document.
- Walks users through questions to flesh out each section (e.g., elevator pitch, player verbs, system decomposition).
- Covers major GDD areas: technical specs, UI/UX, audio, content pipeline, monetization, and accessibility.
